Damion “Damizza” Young on Instagram: "Leonid Radvinsky, owner of OnlyFans, has passed at 43.
Love it or hate it, he helped reshape the creator economy—turning content into a direct-to-fan, subscription model where creators own their revenue.

Now that same blueprint is spreading everywhere.

Bigger question: it’s not if this model wins…it’s who controls it next."
